text: The full untuned warm card reached 32/48 sealed implementation jobs before sparse shortest-path exposed a harness efficiency flaw. Verified public prepared baselines include: WL subtree MUTAG 127.9/120.1 ms Grakern vs 20.8/17.8 GraKeL; sparse 2495.8/2496.9 vs 61.0/57.2; dense 1270.1/1179.4 vs 52.3/50.2; regular prepared 35.8 Grakern vs 30.4 GraKeL vs 16.6 GraphKernels.jl. WL-OA is a speed win: MUTAG 165.3/160.5 vs 196.9/191.0; multiplicity 928.3/840.4 vs 1612.0/1495.2. Shortest-path MUTAG is a large speed win: 20.1/17.9 Grakern vs 85.7/84.8 GraKeL vs 327.8/322.5 Julia. Grakern has material peak-memory losses on every measured row, generally 0.5-1.6 GiB. Sparse shortest-path fork 0 measured 45.5 ms Grakern, 358 ms GraKeL, 12469 ms Julia; applying one shared standard or expensive policy would either waste ~3 hours on Julia or leave faster receipts below the 30-second floor. Repaired expensive sampling to be per implementation: slow jobs use 5x5 while faster peers retain 10x30; the deterministic schedule rotates all active jobs then continues balanced among remaining jobs. Added strict plan parsing, full group-schedule artifacts, mixed-policy resume integration, and 19 passing court tests plus Ruff.
